D/ SABINA AVGUSTA ; R/ IVNONI REGINAE

Silver coin. Denarius of Sabina (128-137) in fine condition, as kindly identified by Andrew Brown, as RIC (2nd ed.) II.3, p. 246, no. 2550. Obverse description: Bust coiffed with hair piled at front, draped, right. Obverse inscription: SABINA AVGUSTA. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left with vertical sceptre, right hand extended with patera. Reverse inscription: IVNONI REGINAE. Diameter: 17.8mm, Weight: 2.66gms, die axis: 6
